newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Daya Sakti Unggul soar on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Daya Sakti Unggul soar on debut.

text.p: Indonesian plywood company PT Daya Sakti Unggul soared on its debut on Tuesday on the Jakarta Stock Exchange, brokers said.
It rose to a high of 1,150 rupiah, compared with its offer price of 950 rupiah, before easing to 1,125 rupiah in late morning trade. Volume was about 13 million shares.
"Response from the market, particularly local investors, is good. Look at the price, it is quite encouraging," a broker with a Singapore-based firm said.
Brokers linked the encouraging listing to the group's fundamentals coupled with news that plywood prices in the international market had improved the last few months.
Brokers expected Daya Sakti's price to hover at the 1,100 to 1,125 rupiah level on support from the underwriter and issuer.
"It's also linked to the overall market, which has improved following rises of some big-capitalised stocks," a broker with a local firm said.
PT Daya Sakti floated 50 million shares, with PT Mashill Securities and Daiwa Securities acting as lead managers.
